doc: Task 11c: a cap_add field changes nothing: the effective capability set is empty.

args: set -e; podman pull -q docker.io/library/busybox:1.36 >/dev/null; d=$(podman image inspect --format '{{.Digest}}' docker.io/library/busybox:1.36); mkdir -p $ROOT/work;  printf '(drgnx-settings :version 1 (drgnx-agents-container-images (("busybox" . "docker.io/library/busybox@%s"))) )\n' "$d" > $CONFIG/settings.el; chmod 600 $CONFIG/settings.el

argv: grep -q "^CapEff:.0000000000000000" /proc/self/status && ! mount -t tmpfs x /mnt 2>/dev/null && echo caps-dropped
